requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the submitted ESA samples and confirm the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation are present, clearly legible and indelible (e.g. after a rub test).

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp ESA sample for the presence of an R10 approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3; pass if the mark is affixed.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if it contains a circle with the letter E followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if '10R-' followed by the approval number appears to the right of the E circle.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review design and R10 test results of the lamp ESA; pass if all emission and immunity requirements of the Regulation are met in normal use conditions.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report covers radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity tests of the lamp ESA; pass if all four are performed and passed.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the broadband emission test report shows measurement of the lamp ESA per the Annex 7 method.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 400 MHz; pass if all values stay below the logarithmic 62-52 / 52-63 dBµV/m limit line of Appendix 6.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all values are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all broadband emission measurements of the lamp ESA with the 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if every value is below the limit.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the narrowband emission test report shows measurement of the lamp ESA per the Annex 8 method.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 from 30 to 400 MHz; pass if all values stay below the 52-42 / 42-53 dBµV/m limit line of Appendix 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all values are below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all narrowband emission measurements of the lamp ESA with the 6.6.2.1 limits; pass if every value is below the limit.

requirements.text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Confirm transient conducted emission testing of the lamp ESA was performed per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10 against Table 1 levels.

requirements.text: For positive polarity, the emission of the ESA representative of its type shall not exceed a maximum allowed pulse amplitude of +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems or +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions per ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines; pass if positive pulses do not exceed +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: For negative polarity, the emission of the ESA representative of its type shall not exceed a maximum allowed pulse amplitude of -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems or -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions per ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines; pass if negative pulses do not exceed -100 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V) in magnitude.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the immunity test report identifies the Annex 9 method(s) (stripline, TEM cell, BCI, ALSE or reverberation chamber) used on the lamp ESA.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check the radiated immunity test of the lamp ESA was performed per Annex 9.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Verify that in over 90 % of the band the applied level met Table 2a (e.g. ALSE 30 V/m 80-2,000 MHz and 10 V/m 2-6 GHz, BCI 60 mA) with no degradation of the lamp functions.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied level never fell below Table 2b minima (e.g. ALSE 25 V/m below 2 GHz and 8 V/m above, BCI 50 mA) across the whole band with no degradation of the lamp functions.

requirements.text: During the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" of the ESA representative of its type, for it to be considered as complying with immunity requirements.
requirements.test_case: Perform radiated immunity tests per Annex 9 while monitoring the lamp functions; pass if no degradation of the immunity related functions (e.g. stop lamp, rear position lamp output) occurs.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows conducted transient immunity testing per ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 at the Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V) for 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III is achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a at +37 V for 500 pulses; pass if lamp functions show FPSC I (immunity related) / III (others).

requirements.text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V) or +20 V (24 V) for 10 pulses; pass if FPSC II (immunity related) / III (others) is achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) or -150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (others) is achieved.

requirements.text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related) / III (others) is achieved.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the starting profile test result is assessed using the ISO 16750-1 functional status classification.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify pulse 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b results are classified using the ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile level II for 10 pulses at 12 V; pass if the lamp reaches the required functional status class (B/D or C).

requirements.text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile level II for 10 pulses at 24 V; pass if the lamp reaches the required functional status class (B/D or C).

requirements.text: The ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7.
requirements.test_case: Take series-production ESAs and verify by EMC testing that they meet the paragraph 6 requirements of the approved type.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband emissions of a series ESA per Annexes 7/8 and confirm levels do not exceed the paragraph 6.5.2.1/6.6.2.1 limits by more than 4 dB.

requirements.text: When the conformity of an ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
requirements.test_case: Expose a series ESA to radiated fields up to 80 % of the paragraph 6.8.2.1 limits per Annex 9 and confirm no observable degradation of the lamp functions.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses at paragraph 6.9.1 levels and measure conducted emissions per paragraph 6.7.1 on a series unit; confirm no degradation of immunity-related functions and emissions within limits.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 30-75 MHz frequency band (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 with 120 kHz bandwidth in 30-75 MHz and verify all values are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 75-400 MHz frequency band (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth in 75-400 MHz and verify all values are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth in 400-1,000 MHz and verify all values are at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 30-75 MHz frequency band (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 with 120 kHz bandwidth in 30-75 MHz and verify all values are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 75-400 MHz frequency band (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth in 75-400 MHz and verify all values are at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband emissions shall not exceed the reference limit E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth in the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth in 400-1,000 MHz and verify all values are at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test of broadband electromagnetic emissions from the ESA shall be performed according CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the broadband radiated emission measurement of the lamp ESA was performed according to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test set-up record shows the lamp operated in normal mode with its light functions energised at maximum load during the measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows the ALSE set-up of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 was used for the lamp ESA.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp ESA broadband emissions were measured over the full 30 to 1,000 MHz range and remain below the applicable limits throughout.

requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz, except that if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements of this Annex.
requirements.test_case: Run the radiated emission scan over 30 to 1,000 MHz at CISPR 12 intervals (or at the 14 highest-emission frequencies per band with accredited data) and confirm all readings are below the limits.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure the narrowband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the narrowband emission test report and confirm the test setup and procedure follow CISPR 25 except where Annex 8 states otherwise.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan/report that all lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing) were operated in normal mode at maximum load during the narrowband emission measurement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test of the ESA shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report states the ALSE method per CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 (or a compliant OATS alternative) was used.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the measured narrowband emissions of the lamp ESA are below the limits over the full 30 to 1,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the receiver settings in the test report show an average detector was used.

requirements.text: The ESAs may comply with the requirements of the absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, in any combination with the other test methods at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.test_case: Review the immunity test plan/report and confirm the selected method(s) together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range of paragraph 3.1.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for the immunity testing of ESAs to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report states frequency range and general test conditions per ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions of the ESA during tests shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report documents test conditions in accordance with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the test setup record that the lamp ESA was powered on throughout the immunity exposure.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the lamp functions (rear position, stop, reversing) were operated in normal operating mode during exposure and monitored.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test setup photos/description against the arrangement defined in Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

requirements.text: The measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with frequency steps per ISO 11452-1 and the ESA meets the immunity criteria over that range.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows AM 1 kHz, 80 per cent depth applied from 20 to 400 MHz with the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) applied from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz with the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) applied from 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz with the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the documented step size and dwell time comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: For the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Check the absorber chamber test report states field calibration by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Verify the absorber chamber test report shows antenna in vertical polarization and the ESA meeting its immunity criteria.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Review the BCI test report to confirm ISO 11452-4 (or ISO 11451-4 in-vehicle) was applied with the injection probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop) from the ESA.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp's supply lines and operationally connected inputs and verify the required FPSC is reached.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp's supply lines (unless exclusively for electric vehicles) and verify the required functional status class.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient emissions from the lamp on its supply lines and operationally connected lines per ISO 7637-2 and confirm compliance with the regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp after vibration exposure under normal conditions of use and verify that its photometric and geometric characteristics remain within the Regulation's limits.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting (fasteners, mounting holes) on the vehicle and verify that the lamp cannot be shifted out of aim without deliberate tool action.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp's reference axis on the vehicle and confirm it is parallel to the road bearing plane within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed rear lamp's reference axis and confirm it is parallel to the vehicle median longitudinal plane within ±3°.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the orientation of the reference axis of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Check that the measured reference axis deviation in each direction does not exceed ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Review the manufacturer's fitting instructions and verify the installed lamp conforms to them.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Place the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface and measure lamp height and orientation in the defined condition.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure left and right lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane based on exterior form and confirm symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of left and right lamps and confirm mirror symmetry about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of left and right lamps for each function and confirm both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps for each function and confirm they are substantially identical.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each grouped/combined function of the rear lamp individually meets its colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and chromaticity of each function with all other functions of the lamp switched OFF and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: With the rear position lamp and the reciprocally incorporated function both ON, measure chromaticity of the other function and confirm it meets its colour requirement.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project the distinct parts of the apparent surface along the reference axis and confirm they occupy at least 60 % of the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the gap between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts perpendicular to the reference axis and confirm it does not exceed 75 mm.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system, except that a lamp in the shape of a band or strip may be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp classification and confirm lamps sharing the housing/common outer lens are not declared as an interdependent lamp system (unless band/strip).

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle per paragraph 5.10.4.1 that the red apparent surfaces of the lamp are not directly visible from Zone 1 at 25 m in front.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface along the reference axis and compare with the height limits.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Where reduced geometric visibility angles are claimed for low mounting, measure lamp height from the H plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each lamp function continuously and verify intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON.

requirements.text: To verify paragraph 5.10.1., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observe from all points of Zone 1 in a transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle (Annex 4) and confirm no red apparent surface of the lamp is directly visible.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity of red light emitted towards the front (including vehicle body influence) and confirm it is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the vehicle lighting switch and verify the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position lamps, marker lamps and rear registration plate lamp.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Switch the function ON and OFF and verify all light sources of the interdependent lamp system switch simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector are not concealable.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp light and confirm it falls within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp light and confirm it falls within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp light and confirm it falls within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the light reflected by the rear non-triangular retro-reflector and confirm it is red.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted on the vehicle and compare with the numbers in the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: If the lamp is on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamp at every fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component open, assess that the lamp and retro-reflector do not cause undue glare or discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Operate the movable component repeatedly and check that the lamp returns each time to the manufacturer-specified position in the normal position of use.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in each manufacturer-specified fixed position, measure the hidden portion of the apparent surface along the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be allowed, provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Vary the controlling condition and measure intensities of all combined/grouped/reciprocally incorporated R2/S2 lamps; pass if they vary together in the same manner and similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop and rear position lamp intensities throughout variation transitions; pass if the prescribed intensity ratio is maintained across the range.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except that the means of controlling the maximum voltage at the terminals of the device may, for convenience, be located within the body of the device, and except that this provision shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle in constant voltage operation; pass if it does not exceed 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp on the vehicle across its angles of geometric visibility and confirm no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, other than obstacles present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Review the geometric visibility measurement set-up and confirm near-field observations are shifted parallel to the direction of observation from infinity.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry of the lamp with the hidden portion masked and confirm the values still meet the device approval photometric requirements.

requirements.text: When the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal may be reduced to 5º (lamp at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit may be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp height per paragraph 5.8.1 and, if below 750 mm, confirm the photometric field is verified down to at least 5° below horizontal.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify the geometric visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: A LED module does not need to be replaceable, if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp's component type approval communication sheet states the LED module is non-replaceable where it cannot be replaced.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector carry valid type approvals and markings under the device Regulations referenced in paragraph 6.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check fitted replaceable light sources bear approvals for the light source categories stated in the lamp approval under R37, R99 or R128.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the reversing lamp carries a valid UN R23 or UN R148 approval mark and certificate.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the illuminating surface height above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if within 250 mm to 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the apparent surface is visible over α = 15° up/5° down and β = 45° each side (one device) or 45° out/30° in (two devices).

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and confirm its reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional vehicle test: engage reverse with propulsion system operable and confirm lamp lights; confirm it cannot be lit otherwise.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional vehicle test: disengage reverse or switch off propulsion system while lamp is on; pass if lamp switches off and stays off.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for the reversing lamp shall be optional, except that a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review component regulation and vehicle: if a failure tell-tale is required, verify it is fitted and indicates reversing lamp failure.

requirements.text: Devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the stop lamp carries a valid approval mark/certificate under UN R7 02 series or later or UN R148 00 series or later.

requirements.text: All categories of vehicles shall be equipped with two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
requirements.test_case: Count the stop lamps on the vehicle: two S1/S2 devices (left and right rear lamp) and one S3/S4 device shall be present.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices, the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop lamp apparent surface height above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle/CAD that the stop lamp apparent surface is unobstructed over 45° inward and outward (20° inward under H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle/CAD that the stop lamp apparent surface is unobstructed 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp to confirm the stop lamp reference axis points rearward.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the brake signal on the vehicle and confirm all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for the stop lamps shall be optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component approval for a failure tell-tale requirement and, if required, verify the tell-tale activates on simulated stop lamp failure.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps (devices of R or R1 or R2 categories) shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and approval documents to confirm that rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position lamps on the vehicle and check that each carries an R7 (02 series or later) or R148 (00 series or later) approval mark; pass if two approved lamps are present.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces of the rear position lamps in the direction of the reference axes shall have no special requirement.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the vehicle is M1; no minimum inner-edge separation needs to be verified.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above the ground per paragraph 5.8.1 on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified).

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle to confirm the rear position lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the apparent surface is unobstructed from 45° inwards (or 20° below H if mounted below 750 mm) to 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the apparent surface is unobstructed from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle that the apparent surface of the rear position lamp is visible from 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamp shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify visibility of the rear position lamp from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, when the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is used, to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface at the boundary angles; pass if at least 12.5 cm2.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, when the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is used, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the unobstructed apparent surface of the rear position lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check that the retro-reflector area is excluded when computing the 12.5 cm2 visible apparent surface.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp to confirm its reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections for rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review wiring and functional test on vehicle to confirm rear position lamp switching complies with paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps and verify the closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Verify on vehicle that a single tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Simulate lamp failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates where required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and confirm non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear retro-reflectors fitted and check that each carries a Class IA or IB approval mark under UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 (00 series or later).

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the non-triangular rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if it is no more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: The non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the retro-reflector height above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if it is between 250 mm and 900 mm, or up to 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, or up to 1,500 mm if the bodywork shape makes it necessary.

requirements.text: In length, the non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm the retro-reflectors are located at the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be defined by a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle or a layout drawing that the illuminating surface is unobstructed through 30° inwards and 30° outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be defined by a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check that the illuminating surface is unobstructed through 10° up and 10° down, or 5° down if mounted below 750 mm per paragraph 5.8.1.

requirements.text: The non-triangular rear retro-reflectors shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the non-triangular rear retro-reflector shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Compare the retro-reflector illuminating surface with the apparent surfaces of the other rear lamps on the drawing; any overlap is permitted.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON, except that the rear position lamps may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON, and may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, activate the daytime running lamps at ambient light at or below 7,000 lux (measured per Annex 13) and verify the rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify all stop lamps operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure flashing frequency and phase of all lamps; pass if in phase at 3.0-5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall operate independently of other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal with other lamps on and off and verify its operation is unaffected.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON and OFF automatically.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the emergency stop signal activates and deactivates without driver action.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be switched ON only when the vehicle speed is above 50 km/h and the braking system is providing the emergency braking logic signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Test emergency braking below and above 50 km/h; pass if the signal activates only above 50 km/h with the logic signal present.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be automatically switched OFF if the emergency braking logic signal as defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H is no longer provided or if the hazard warning signal is activated.
requirements.test_case: Remove the emergency braking logic signal or activate the hazard warning signal and verify the emergency stop signal switches off.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured mounting distances of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector with their individual specifications; all values within limits.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, measure the width, height and length position of the rear lamp per paragraphs 2.10.2.-2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; the check is documented.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure visibility angles (e.g. reversing lamp 45° outboard) on a production vehicle; values meet the lamp specifications within the ±3° allowance.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the angles of geometric visibility of lamps shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check the geometric visibility angles of each rear lamp function per paragraph 2.10.7.; the check is documented.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check per paragraph 5.10. that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front and no white light (other than permitted reversing lamp) is visible from the rear.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Verify on a production vehicle that switching logic and tell-tales of the rear lamp functions comply with paragraphs 5.11.-5.14. and the individual lamp specifications.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions via the vehicle electrical system on a production vehicle; each lamp operates.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Confirm by visual inspection that the colours (red rear position/stop/retro-reflector, white reversing), number and categories of the lamps meet paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and the individual lamp specifications.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the rear lamps and their markings on a production vehicle for presence, number, colour, arrangement and category.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the function list of the combination lamp and confirm that no integrated lamp lacks compliance evidence against an applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions and the retro-reflector of the combination unit each have test results showing compliance with UN R148 or another applicable Regulation.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect drawing and sample for a marking area large enough to carry the approval marking and other required markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect markings for legibility and rub-test for indelibility; markings remain legible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimension "a" of the approval marking; pass if ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for a circle surrounding "E" followed by the approving country number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for a 4 to 6 digit sequential number matching the approval number.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect that the sequential number is located adjacent to the E-circle approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for the symbols of each approved function (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) per Table 1.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking for "148R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at approval.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of, on lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: For a handed lamp, inspect the approval marking for a horizontal arrow indicating mounting position.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check that the horizontal arrow on the rear position lamp points outward from the vehicle when installed.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: For a reversing lamp with reduced light distribution, check that the horizontal arrow points outward from the vehicle.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of, on lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: For a lamp with reduced light distribution, inspect for a downward vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the production lamp for presence of the complete approval marking.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: If light sources are replaceable, inspect the lamp for marking of the prescribed light source category(ies).

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: If approved for LED substitute light sources, inspect the lamp for marking of the LED substitute light source category(ies).

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a legible rated voltage (6V, 12V or 24V) or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with a variable luminous intensity control, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable light source module for the applicant's trade name or mark; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for its specific identification code; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.test_case: Check the module code begins with "MD" followed by the approval mark without circle (plus distinguishing characters for non-identical modules); pass if so.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for a rated voltage or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code matching the module marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
