requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage or voltage range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the approval mark in the specific identification code of the module and the approval mark on the lamp in which the module is used shall be from the same applicant, although the approval mark does not have to be the same as the one on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare module and lamp approval marks; pass if both belong to the same applicant.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the separate control gear for its identification number and manufacturer name; pass if both present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and drawings to confirm the approval marking is on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting transparent part; pass if so.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: Fit the lamp on the vehicle and check the approval marking is visible directly or with the boot lid/door opened; pass if visible.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: If the lens is detachable, inspect both the lens and the main body for the approval marking; pass if present on both.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device main body under the shared lens; pass if it bears only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the approval marking and the applicable markings of 3.3.3.2 to 3.3.3.6; pass if all are affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: The markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.5.(a) shall be affixed on the component.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the replaceable light source module; pass if the 3.3.3.5(a) markings are affixed on it.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check the single approval mark is visible; pass if visible.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Check that no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark; pass if so.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark; pass if none is smaller than the minimum size of the smallest individual mark required.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Verify by type-approval testing that the lamp meets all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp against UN R48 sections 5 and 6 (series in force at application) for rear position, stop and reversing lamps; pass if all verifiable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 provisions pertinent to each lamp function for M1 vehicles, verifiable at lamp type approval, have been assessed and are met.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and the lamps retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Perform vibration and environmental tests, then re-measure photometry and colour; pass if the lamp operates and retains the prescribed characteristics.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, these functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the LED circuit design; pass if the functions use multiple light sources or the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the stop lamp and reversing lamp apparent surfaces; pass if no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring schematic; groups of series-wired LEDs that all extinguish on single failure are treated as one light source in failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced, in which case the lamp is only for use on a vehicle fitted with a tell-tale indicating failure.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source (group) and measure Annex 3 points; pass if minima are met (and maxima not exceeded with all sources lit) or a failure tell-tale signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure the rear position lamp intensity; verify it automatically meets the steady (R1) intensity requirements.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure the stop lamp intensity; verify it automatically meets the steady (S1) intensity requirements.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Review the bill of materials and samples; verify every light source is an R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable source, a light source module or a non-replaceable light source.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light sources in all orientations; verify they can only be fixed in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the IEC 60061 holder data sheet for the prescribed light source category; verify conformity.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform radiated and conducted emission tests (e.g. per UN R10) on the lamp; verify no disturbance causes malfunction of other vehicle systems.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the module in other positions and to remove it without tools; verify only correct fitting is possible and removal requires tools.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the module design; verify it cannot be opened or modified without destruction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with UN approved light sources and other modules in the housing; verify it is not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another one bearing the same identification code and repeat photometric measurements; verify all requirements are met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraphs 4.8.1.1. to 4.8.1.10. (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3).
requirements.test_case: Review the test report; verify photometric and colorimetric measurements were made under the conditions of 4.8.1 and Annex 3.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report; verify measurements were made with the lamp's own LEDs/modules installed.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report; verify intensities were measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report/drawings; verify the apparent surface limits in the reference axis direction are determined for each lamp function.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test supply voltage at the lamp was 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system) as applicable.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated for testing as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp was operated during testing according to the applicant's specified operating conditions.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples at HV for each function; pass if intensity ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan the full visible field of both samples for each function; pass if no measured intensity exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5. by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure for each function; pass if every point meets the required percentage of minimum or the specified intensity value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles for each function; pass if all values ≥ the minimum required in paragraph 5.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the measured light distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions; pass if no violation.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Drive the variable intensity control through all states and measure intensities; pass if all within the paragraph 5 range.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table, except that if one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities in the ±5° V / ±10° H field with both functions on and with the rear position lamp alone; pass if ratio ≥ 5:1 at every point.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review the photometric test report to confirm the Annex 8 procedure was applied.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Perform colorimetric measurements within the Annex 3 grid for each function; pass if the chromaticity complies.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually and colorimetrically inspect light outside the Annex 3 grid; pass if no sharp colour change is observed.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics of the colour of the light emitted, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm colorimetric tests used the paragraph 4.8 conditions (with the lamp's own light sources if non-replaceable).

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples; all Table 4 minimum, maximum and distribution values for the applicable category are met.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of categories R1, MR or RM1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙100 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.7∙101 cd when used as a single lamp or 8.5∙100 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 5∙10-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure on axis and over Figure A3-I grid; intensity between 4 cd and 17 cd (8.5 cd if marked D) and at least 0.05 cd within Table A2-1 visibility angles.

requirements.text: A luminous intensity of 6.0∙101 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: For a reciprocally incorporated rear position lamp, verify that intensities above Table 4 maximum occur only below 5° down and do not exceed 60 cd.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the rear position lamps within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the boundaries of the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles; each value is at least 0.05 cd.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failure per paragraph 4.6 and verify the lamp behaviour meets the paragraph 4.6 provisions.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamps shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the rear position lamp light; they fall within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement of both stop lamp samples; pass if all Table 7 values for the declared category are met.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity on axis and over the Figure A3-I grid and Table A2-1 visibility angles; pass if 60 cd ≤ I(axis), I ≤ 260 cd (130 cd if marked D), distribution and ≥0.3 cd within visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure day and night intensity levels over Figure A3-I and Table A2-1 angles; pass if 60 cd min, max 730 cd (365 cd if marked D) and ≥0.3 cd (day)/≥0.07 cd (night) within visibility angles.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles; pass if values are not below the Table 7 minimum for the category.

requirements.text: The failure provisions for stop lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Verify by design review and failure simulation that the stop lamp meets the provisions of paragraph 4.6.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of stop lamp light with a spectroradiometer; pass if within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the reversing lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both reversing lamp samples; all values comply with Table 10 limits.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) shall be 8.0∙101 cd, the maximum luminous intensity (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)) shall be 3.00∙102 cd in or above the h-plane, 6.00∙102 cd below the h-plane down to 5°D and 8.00∙103 cd below 5°D, with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and angles of geometric visibility (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)) not applicable, as specified in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of the reversing lamp: on-axis minimum ≥80 cd, maxima ≤300 cd (in/above h-plane), ≤600 cd (down to 5°D), ≤8000 cd (below 5°D), distribution per Figure A3-V.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensity at 30° inwards; value is at least 25 cd.

requirements.text: The failure provisions for reversing lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Review reversing lamp design and failure behaviour against paragraph 4.6; compliant.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp light; chromaticity within white limits.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare production samples of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps against the approved type documentation; pass if construction, markings and performance match the approved type.

requirements.text: When the compliance with the requirements set forth in paragraph 5. is verified, no measured value of the lamps shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure production lamps for each function; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3 the measured values of the lamps shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Measure production lamps at the field points of Annexes 2 and 3; pass if values meet the Table 12 equivalent values.

requirements.text: For front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2), the minimum angles of geometric visibility shall be 45°/80° horizontal (inboard / outboard), or 20°/80° used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, and 15°/15° vertical (above / below), or 15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, or 5°/15° for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, as specified in Table A2-1, the angles shown being correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check of the rear position lamp light-emitting surface visibility at 45° inboard, 80° outboard, 15° up and 15° down (or the reduced angles per mounting height); pass if the apparent surface is visible over the whole required field.

requirements.text: For stop lamps (S1, S2), the minimum angles of geometric visibility shall be 45°/45° horizontal (inboard / outboard), or 20°/45° used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm, and 15°/15° vertical (above / below), or 15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm, or 5°/15° for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm, as specified in Table A2-1, the angles shown being correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check of the stop lamp light-emitting surface visibility at 45° inboard, 45° outboard, 15° up and 15° down (or the reduced angles per mounting height); pass if the apparent surface is visible over the whole required field.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the minimum intensities given by the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV, for the various directions of measurement, as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits, except that in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (a) Front and rear direction indicators lamps; (b) Front and rear position lamps; (c) Front and rear end-outline marker lamps; (d) Parking lamps; (e) Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS; (f) Side marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Compute the minimum intensity per measuring direction from the percentage in the figure, round down to three significant digits, and verify measured values meet it (only to 5° down if mounting height ≤ 750 mm).

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric scan between grid points; pass if every intermediate direction meets at least the lowest surrounding grid minimum.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: If local intensity variations are seen on the reversing lamp, measure between adjacent measuring directions; pass if no value is below 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) as shown in the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp intensity at each Figure A3-I point; pass if each value ≥ the stated percentage of the Table minimum.

requirements.text: The stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) as shown in the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp intensity at each Figure A3-I point; pass if each value ≥ the stated percentage of the Table 7 minimum.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall meet, for the various directions of measurement expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference, the minimum intensities in cd shown in Figure A3-V.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensity at each Figure A3-V point relative to the reference axis; pass if each value ≥ the cd value in the figure.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare dimensions and construction of production lamps with the approved type; pass if deviations are only inevitable manufacturing deviations within the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric performance of randomly selected production lamps per paragraph 4.8; pass if results meet the paragraph 4.8 criteria.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function of production lamps under paragraph 4.9 conditions; pass if coordinates lie within the specified colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences of the mass-produced lamps do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and measure randomly sampled production lamps against the approved drawings; pass if mechanical and geometric differences are within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometric performance of a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8.; pass if no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced lamps shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of sampled production lamps under the conditions of paragraph 4.9.; pass if they are within the prescribed colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric values of the four randomly selected lamps (samples A and B); pass if no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED reversing lamp and measure the luminous intensities after 1 min and after 10 min; all values must lie within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED rear position and stop lamp functions and measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 min (or photometric stability); all values must lie within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm all functions use LED only and that measurements per paragraph 1.2 are compliant, so no additional time-point testing is needed.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to each type approved shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector sample and verify that the assigned approval number is marked on the device as required by paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) shall be IA, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the retro-reflector and confirm the symbol IA is shown with character size a ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) shall be IB, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the retro-reflector and confirm the symbol IB is shown with character size a ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device drawing and sample to confirm a marking space large enough for the UI or the approval marking plus other markings per paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the markings for legibility and perform a rub/durability check to confirm they remain indelible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking characters and confirm dimension a meets the minimum given in Table 1 for the device class (5 mm for IA/IB).

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle enclosing the letter E followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval number per paragraph 3.2.3.2.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking layout to confirm the sequential number is located adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) per Table 1 of paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at the time of approval.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I Unique Identifier (UI).
requirements.test_case: Visually compare the UI mark on the retro-reflective device with the format of Figure I; pass if it matches.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector; pass if the applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective devices shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether the retro-reflector is rotation-sensitive; if so, verify 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the device; pass if approval mark/UI, trade name and any TOP marking are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the marking shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installed on the vehicle; pass if the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to detach each light-transmitting part (lens, retro-reflector); pass if none can be removed without also removing the approval mark/UI.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mark components; pass if each is at least the minimum size of the smallest individual mark required by the pertinent regulations.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Test production samples against paragraphs 4 and 5; pass if they meet the requirements and match the approved type.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at application; pass if all feasible provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check the R48 requirements pertinent to a rear retro-reflector on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at device approval; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect construction and verify photometric performance before and after the Annex test sequence; pass if it functions satisfactorily throughout.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples for design or manufacturing defects; pass if none detrimental to operation or maintenance are found.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector components by hand without tools; pass if they cannot be easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect and wipe the outer surface; pass if it can be cleaned easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface for roughness and protuberances; pass if smooth and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; pass if the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to separate the optical unit and filter under normal use conditions; pass if they cannot be separated.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Check BOM and inspect the retro-reflector; pass if colour is obtained by mass-tinted material and not by paint or varnish.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of retro-reflected light under Illuminant A; pass if x,y lie within the R48 night-time red limits.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Set up colour test with CIE Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle); pass if test conditions are as specified.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure retro-reflector dimensions and shape against Annex 5; pass if compliant (e.g. non-triangular shape).

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL and colour per paragraphs 5.1.4 to 5.1.5; pass if all values meet the specified limits.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Run the paragraph 5.1.7 physical/mechanical test sequence on samples; pass if all requirements are met.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of retro-reflectors of the Classes IA and IB shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6.
requirements.test_case: Subject ten samples to the Annex 6 Part 1 heat resistance test after general and dimensional checks; pass if samples show no deformation and proceed to optical checks.

requirements.text: At least one hour after the heat resistance test, the ten samples of retro-reflectors of the Classes IA and IB shall be examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure colour and RI at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° at least 1 h after heat test; pass if values meet paragraphs 5.1.5 and 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Perform full RI measurement per paragraph 5.1.4 on the min and max samples; pass if all Table 3 values are met.

requirements.text: The two samples of the first group shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Run Annex 6 Part 2 water penetration test then Annex 7 Parts 1 and 2 fuel/lubricant tests on two samples; pass if no water ingress and no surface damage.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure night-time colour of each group after the 5.1.3.1 tests; pass if chromaticity is within paragraph 5.1.5 limits.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI of each group after the 5.1.3.1 tests; pass if values meet paragraph 5.1.4 minima.

requirements.text: The verification of the RI of the retro-reflectors after undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1. shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Check post-test RI at α = 20', β1 = β2 = 0° (or Annex 4 Part 1 positions if necessary); pass if minima are met.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered.
requirements.test_case: Mask the device to the illuminating surface within a 200 mm diameter circle during RI measurement; pass if measurement uses only that area.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, the illuminating surface of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.test_case: Measure the illuminating surface area used for photometry; pass if it does not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1 paragraph 3 at all Table 3 angles; pass if each value is at or above the Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: For red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence α of 20', the RI values shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at α = 20' at the three angle pairs; pass if ≥ 300, 200 and 100 mcd/lx respectively.

requirements.text: For red retro-reflectors of Class IA and IB at an angle of divergence α of 1°30', the RI values shall be equal to or greater than 5 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.8 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and 2.5 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at α = 1°30' at the three angle pairs; pass if ≥ 5, 2.8 and 2.5 mcd/lx respectively.

requirements.text: RI values of the retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 shall not be permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the solid angle bounded by (±10°,0°) and (±5°,±20°); pass if no value falls below the applicable Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: For a mounting height < 750 mm, verify RI downward angles only to 5°; pass if minima are met within that range.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform night-time colour measurement per paragraph 4.2.1; pass if the method is followed and results recorded.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of reflected light; pass if within UN R48 night-time red limits (for a red rear retro-reflector).

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors of the Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm that the Class IA/IB samples were tested in the Table 4 sequence.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples a to j shall be subjected to the heat test according to Part 1 of Annex 6 for 48 h at 65° ± 2°C followed by visual inspection for distortion as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Expose samples a-j to 65 ± 2 °C for 48 h and inspect; pass if no distortion is visible.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples a to j shall be subjected to the general specifications visual inspection as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples a-j against the general specifications; pass if all conform.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples a to j shall be subjected to the shapes and dimensions visual inspection according to Annex 5 as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples a-j for shape and dimensions per Annex 5; pass if all conform.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples a to j shall be subjected after the heat test to the colorimetry check according to paragraph 4.2. by visual inspection, with trichromatic coordinates in case of doubt, as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Check colour visually (and measure trichromatic coordinates if in doubt) on samples a-j; pass if within paragraph 4.2 limits.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples a to j shall be subjected to photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4 limited to 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL of samples a-j at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; pass if Part 1 of Annex 4 values are met.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples c and d shall be subjected to complete photometry according to Part 1 of Annex 4 as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Perform complete photometric measurement on samples c and d; pass if all Annex 4 values are met.

requirements.text: For the Classes IA and IB, samples g and h shall be subjected to the water test according to Part 3 of Annex 6 for 10 min. in normal position and 10 min. in inverted position followed by visual inspection as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Immerse samples g and h 10 min normal and 10 min inverted, then inspect; pass if no water penetration/defect.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure production retro-reflector dimensions and geometry against the approved type; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL of a randomly chosen production retro-reflector at the prescribed points; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum values.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of production retro-reflectors; pass if they lie within the prescribed colour limits.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Compare dimensions and mechanical features of production retro-reflectors against the approved type; pass if differences are within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL of randomly chosen production retro-reflectors; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum values.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of production retro-reflectors; pass if coordinates are within the prescribed colour limits.

requirements.text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device.
requirements.test_case: During RI measurement at β1 = β2 = 0°, slightly turn the device and record whether a mirror effect occurs.

requirements.text: When the RI of a retro-reflective device is measured for an angle β of β1 = β2 = 0° and any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of β1 = -5°, β2 = 0°.
requirements.test_case: If a mirror effect is observed, verify the RI reading is taken at β1 = -5°, β2 = 0° and meets the specified value.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the minimum RI of retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at the position of minimum RI with β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' divergence; pass if it is not below the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device which is not marked "TOP" shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε, except that if the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ±5° from that position.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at all other specified angles with the device at the minimum-RI ε position (or within ±5° of it); pass if specified values are met.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the device about its reference axis at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' divergence and identify the position of minimum RI.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the RI of retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the rotation about their axes ±5°.
requirements.test_case: Record RI throughout the ±5° rotation; pass if RI never falls below the prescribed value.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.test_case: Check RI at β1 = β2 = 0°, ε = 0°; if ≥150 per cent of the specified value, verify all measurements are made at ε = 0° and meet the specified values.

requirements.text: For testing the retro-reflection the retro-reflective devices shall be illuminated with a CIE Standard Illuminant A (ISO 11664-2:2007(E)/CIE S 014-2/E:2006) and measured as described in Part 1 of Annex 4.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report states illumination with CIE Standard Illuminant A and measurement per Annex 4 Part 1.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if its shape cannot easily be confused with a triangle.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Store the retro-reflector for 48 consecutive hours in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C and verify the logged temperature and duration.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, after being kept for 48 consecutive hours at 65 °C ± 2 °C the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.
requirements.test_case: After the heat exposure, cool the sample for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C and verify the logged conditions.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion, especially of the optical component, is visible.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Strip removable parts and immerse the retro-reflector for 10 min in 50 °C ± 5 °C water with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface; verify logged conditions.

requirements.text: The water penetration test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the immersion with the device turned 180° so the rear face is under about 20 mm of water; verify orientation and depth.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in 25 °C ± 5 °C water; verify logged temperature.

requirements.text: After the resistance to water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reflecting surface after the immersion test; pass if no water has penetrated.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the resistance to water penetration test.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device after immersion; fail if water is clearly visible at the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: Lightly shake off excess water and measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if values meet the criterion in that paragraph.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust test shall be applied to retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB.
requirements.test_case: Confirm from the test report that, where the manufacturer requested the alternative, the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3 were both performed on the Class IB device.

requirements.text: A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as specified in paragraphs 2.2.1. to 2.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test record contains the initial RI measurement of the mounted sample before the water spray exposure.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF during the water spray test.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions were operated at design voltage on a 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycle during the spray test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed inside the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: After draining, inspect, tap and tilt the device; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1; record and compare with the initial RI.

requirements.text: A sample device, mounted on a test fixture, with the initial RI measured and recorded, shall be exposed to dust as specified in paragraphs 2.3.5. and 2.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Verify the initial RI of the mounted sample is recorded before dust exposure.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. and compare with the initial RI.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Subject the retro-reflector to the ISO 9227:2017 saline mist test and verify that the photometric and colorimetric values still meet the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of retro-reflective devices to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: After the corrosion test, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear-face protection for deterioration; pass if none impairs function.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Verify from the test report that the lamp, stripped of removable parts, was exposed to saline mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; pass if no excessive corrosion impairing efficiency is visible.

requirements.text: After the corrosion test, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas, when measured after a recovery period of 48 hours as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6, at an entrance angle of β2 = 5° and an observation angle of α = 20', shall be not less than the value in Table 9 or more than the value in Table 10 respectively.
requirements.test_case: After 48 h recovery, measure RA at β2 = 5°, α = 20' and confirm it is within the Table 9 minimum and Table 10 maximum.

requirements.text: For resistance to fuels, a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for a retro-reflective device.
requirements.test_case: Check the fuel-resistance test report confirms the retro-reflector was exposed to a 70/30 vol. per cent n-heptane/toluol mixture.

requirements.text: After the resistance to fuels test, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: Visual inspection after the fuel wipe: pass if no apparent surface change is visible other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: For resistance to fuels, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the outer and illuminating surface of the retro-reflector with a cotton cloth soaked in the 70/30 n-heptane/toluol mixture and record the procedure.

requirements.text: For resistance to fuels, after about five minutes from wiping with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually.
requirements.test_case: About five minutes after the fuel wipe, visually inspect the retro-reflector surface and record the observation.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, after the resistance to lubricating oils test, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the RI after the oil test per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; pass if it meets the criterion of that paragraph.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Wipe the retro-reflector outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil and record the procedure.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, after about 5 minutes from wiping with detergent lubricating oil, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: Clean the oiled surface about 5 minutes after the wipe and record the procedure.

requirements.text: The approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector and verify the approval number is located close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and verify the approval number digits have the same orientation as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark and verify the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle.
